_about: Origin and insertion of muscles for the atlas info card. Keys are model structure names (same as supply.json). o = origin, i = insertion, n = optional note shown under the text (for example when a part of a muscle shows the text of the whole muscle). Wording is our own, from OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology (CC BY 4.0) and Human Anatomy (OERI, ASCCC; CC BY 4.0). Platysma comes from the course lecture notes. Muscles with no source are left out. Check any change against the lecture notes or a textbook.
_source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology (CC BY 4.0); Human Anatomy, ASCCC Open Educational Resources Initiative (CC BY 4.0)
